messages.subject: Financial Technology Partners Interview Next Steps
messages.body:
Hi Jonathan,

We're excited to move you forward in the interview process for the 2025 Summer Analyst, Investment Banking (San Francisco) position!

To help us schedule, please let us know when you're available by selecting the online calendar link below. Please note, the more options you offer us, the quicker we're able to schedule your interview.

The timing and duration of your interview(s) will also depend on the availability of our interviewer(s), but once we coordinate calendars, we will confirm exact time and duration with you.

Regards,
Caroline

[Greenhouse availability link]
messages.note: Scheduling handed off to a Greenhouse availability form. No calendar invite, no proposed times in the mail. A product watching mail alone sees no scheduling signal here at all.

messages.subject: Re: Financial Technology Partners Interview Next Steps
messages.body:
Hello Caroline,

I hope you are doing well. I submitted my interview availability using the link you provided yesterday evening. I applied to your firm directly via a link I was sent by an analyst following a coffee chat, and it was only from your recent email that I realized I am recruiting exclusively for the San Francisco office. While I am extremely interested in both San Francisco and New York, I have a slight preference for New York. I am wondering how this affects the interview process and recruiting network I am in. I would greatly appreciate it if you could provide any clarification.

Sincerely,
Jonathan

messages.subject: RE: Financial Technology Partners Interview Next Steps
messages.body:
Hi Jonathan,

I hope you are doing well!

We are looking forward to moving you forward in the process. Thank you for letting us know your location preference. We have moved you over to our New York process. You will be receiving an updated availability request for this process.

When you submit your availability, please also include times for next week as well.

Please let me know if you have any additional questions.

Thank you!
Caroline

Caroline Hodge, Campus Recruiter

messages.subject: Financial Technology Partners Interview Next Steps
messages.body:

[same Greenhouse availability template as the San Francisco message, new link]

Regards,
Caroline
messages.note: Identical template body to the 3/18 message, different office. Sent 12 seconds after the human reply above.

messages.subject: Re: Financial Technology Partners Interview Next Steps
messages.body:
Good Morning Caroline,

I greatly appreciate you adjusting me over to the New York process. I just submitted my availability under the new link.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: Financial Technology Partners Interview Next Steps

[Greenhouse availability link]

messages.subject: RE: Financial Technology Partners Interview Next Steps
messages.body:
Hi Jonathan,

Please disregard my email below! Caroline forwarded me your availability for next week, and I’ll send a formal confirmation email once schedules are coordinated.

Thank you.

Best,
Lindsay

Lindsay McEachern, Executive Assistant
messages.note: A retraction sent 2m38s after the message it retracts. Both remain in the mailbox. Any rule reading the latest inbound as the live request would have acted on the wrong one for under three minutes.

messages.subject: Re: Financial Technology Partners Interview Next Steps
messages.body:
Hi Lindsay,

I appreciate the update! I look forward to speaking with some members from the San Francisco office next week.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: Action Required: Wells Fargo 2025 Summer Internship - Investment Banking (San Francisco) | Preference Form
messages.body:
Good afternoon,

We hope this email finds you well. Thank you for applying to the Wells Fargo 2025 Summer Investment Banking Internship Program (San Francisco).

To remain in the process and indicate your group preference, you will need to complete the below group preference form. Please complete it by noon EST on Monday, April 8.

[Preference survey link]

Abey T. Dessie, Recruiter - Early Careers, Corporate and Investment Banking
messages.note: toRecipients is EMPTY - Jon is a bcc recipient. A product that attributes mail by To/Cc match would not connect this message to Jon at all. It also carries a hard deadline ('Action Required', complete by noon Monday).

messages.subject: RE: Action Required: Wells Fargo 2025 Summer Internship - Investment Banking (San Francisco) | Preference Form
messages.body:
Good afternoon,

Thank you to those that have reached out. We will be sending out a new form on Monday. Please disregard the prior email. Enjoy your weekend.

Abey T. Dessie
messages.note: Retracts the deadline set 10 minutes earlier. Also bcc.

messages.subject: RE: Action Required: Wells Fargo 2025 Summer Internship - Investment Banking (San Francisco) | Preference Form
messages.body:
Good afternoon,

Thank you all for our patience. Here is the link to the updated group preference form. The access code is: 2025IBSanFrancisco.

To remain in the process, you will need to complete the form by 1pm EST on Tuesday, April 9.

Abey T. Dessie
messages.note: Third version of the same deadline. Also bcc.

messages.subject: Enjoyed Our Conversation
messages.body:
Hey Brady,

I hope all is well. I just wanted to send a brief email expressing my appreciation for the time you spent with me over the phone today. I enjoyed learning more about the firm and your experience there. Congratulations on your recent promotion!

Best,
Jonathan
messages.note: Thank-you note, same day as the call. The call itself is one of the three 2024-04-05 'Interview with Financial Technology Partners' calendar events, which carry no attendee and no interviewer name.

messages.subject: RE: Enjoyed Our Conversation
messages.body:
Hey Jonathan, thanks for the note. Enjoyed chatting with you as well!

Brady Flynn, Analyst, Financial Technology Partners LP

messages.subject: RE: Enjoyed Our Conversation
messages.body:
Hey Jonathan – congrats on the offer, well deserved! Happy to chat if I can be helpful while you think through the decision.

Brady Flynn, Analyst
messages.note: Sender address casing differs from the earlier message in the same thread (Brady.flynn@ vs Brady.Flynn@). Case-sensitive address matching would treat these as two people.

messages.subject: Re: Enjoyed Our Conversation
messages.body:
Hey Brady,

I appreciate you reaching out to me and offering your willingness to speak. I have since signed the offer. Thank you for your help throughout this process.

Best,
Jonathan Nachman

messages.subject: RE: Enjoyed Our Conversation

Great to hear - congrats, Jonathan!

Brady Flynn, Analyst

Great meeting you. Heard you got the offer, congrats!

Let me know if I can be helpful in your decision process in any way. Happy to hop on the phone and discuss any questions you may have to help you decide.

Billy,

I appreciate you reaching back out. I'll let you know if I have any questions about the offer and would like to speak with you.

Best,
